Dinner above the city lights

Filipino-fusion and Western comfort food, served with a cool Baguio-like breeze and panoramic views of the Metro Manila skyline and the Sierra Madre.

Reserve a tableSee the menu

A hilltop table with a view

Hill House Dining serves elevated Filipino-fusion and Western comfort food in Antipolo, with a cool, Baguio-like breeze and panoramic views of the Metro Manila skyline and the Sierra Madre.

  • Inside the Maura’s Place compound, about an hour from Metro Manila
  • Al fresco deck and cozy indoor seating
  • Dogs welcome indoors and outdoors
  • Open daily from 8:00 AM

    Questions

    Do I need a reservation?

    Reservations are recommended for sunset and weekends, when the deck fills first. Send a request below or call +63 917 160 5469.

    Can I bring my dog?

    Yes. Dogs are allowed both indoors and outdoors.

    Is there parking?

    Yes. There is a free parking lot, plus street parking.

    Can we book a private room?

    A private dining room is available. Mention it in your reservation request.

    How do I get there?

    We are at Pagrai Hills Subdivision, 0011 Granada St, Cupang, Antipolo, inside the Maura's Place compound. Plan for roughly an hour from Metro Manila.

    How to get here

    By car or Grab, search “Hill House Dining” on Waze or Google Maps. We are in Pagrai Hills Subdivision, Barangay Mayamot, near Marcos Highway.

    By public transport: take LRT-2 to Antipolo Station, a jeep or e-trike to Pagrai Market, then a tricycle to Hill House Dining.

    Look for the green Hill House sign

    Official channels: Facebook page Hill House Dining, Instagram hillhousedining, and 0917 160 5469. Please book only through these and this website.
